entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Colonel Burton Curtis Andrus Sr. was a United States Army officer who served in World War II. He was an armor officer for most of his career and his most noted assignment was as the commandant of the Nuremberg Prison which housed the accused during the Nuremberg trials after the end of World War II in Europe.
